intent: Turn the audit ledger into the universal FD-001 and Oyatie Cloud proof stream: selectable receipts route to Workflow, Cloud, Mail, Community, Evidence Graph, and Deployment Gates without wiring any production side effects.
product_direction: Oyatie will build a hyperscaler-grade cloud substrate and dogfood all FD-001 microservices as tenant workloads on that substrate. FD-001 product delivery remains the master-plan product goal; Oyatie Cloud is the substrate that proves the platform can host real production tenants.
implementation_summary: Added a Receipt Stitching Console at the top of the Audit Ledger so Workflow output, Work Hub handoffs, Cloud workload posture, and Deployment Gate packets read as one cohesive proof stream.
Added selectable receipt source cards with title, receipt id, owner, state, route, and detail binding so the proof stream feels like an operational console rather than static copy.
Added local receipt routes to Workflow, Oyatie Cloud, Mail brief, Community note, Evidence Graph, Deployment Gates, and packet sealing; Mail/Community reuse the existing Work Hub handoff bus.
Synchronized receipt selection and routing with Audit Ledger status, Product Activity Spine, command/activity feed, and Work Hub draft state while preserving the visual-only boundary.
Added responsive CSS using the existing dense Bominal/Oyatie command-surface tokens and verified desktop/tablet/mobile no-overflow behavior.

before_metrics.issue: The dashboard had separate Workflow output, Cloud workload, Work Hub, Evidence, and Deployment Gate interactions, but the Audit Ledger did not yet expose a single operator-facing receipt stitcher proving they are one FD-001 tenant workload product on Oyatie Cloud.

visual_ralph_verdict.category_match: Bominal-grade dense evidence console integrated with FD-001 product delivery and Oyatie Cloud substrate proof
differences: Reference Bominal is a standalone local app; this slice intentionally keeps Oyatie shell chrome, audit ledger, Product Activity Spine, and local-only proof language visible.
Receipt routes create browser-local visual state and draft previews rather than real audit vault, deployment, mail, community, billing, or cloud-provider mutations by requirement.
suggestions: Next slices can make Finance, Identity, Intelligence, and People Ops emit identical receipt cards into this stitching console.
A future persistent mock store could retain selected receipt/source/action state across reloads once the prototype moves beyond visual-only state.
A keyboard shortcut layer could make receipt routing feel even closer to a hyperscaler operator console.
visual_ralph_verdict.reasoning: The console is visible in the Audit Ledger fold, uses the established dense command-surface hierarchy, and proves cross-surface routes through browser QA at 1440, 1024, and 390 widths with no horizontal overflow or console errors. It directly embodies the latest direction that FD-001 remains the product goal while Oyatie Cloud proves the platform by hosting those microservices as tenant workloads.

verification.summary: desktop/tablet/mobile receipt select, Mail handoff, Evidence Graph route, Deployment Gates route, Seal action, no console errors, no horizontal overflow

local_only_boundary: No workflow execution, mail send, community publish, backend write, audit vault write, deploy, DNS, billing, IAM, or cloud-provider mutation is wired; all receipt-stitching actions are browser visual state.
